name: Envia Shipping
description:
The Envia Shipping MCP connector gives Claude direct access to the Envia shipping platform. From a single conversation, you can compare carrier rates, purchase shipping labels, track packages, schedule pickups, void labels, and manage ecommerce orders — no switching tabs or copy-pasting data.          
                                                    
Supports domestic and international shipments, optional add-ons (insurance, cash on delivery, signature), HS code classification for customs, commercial invoice generation, and Brazil DCe pre-authorization with SEFAZ. Addresses are auto resolved from postal codes, including Colombia DANE codes.
                             
Available tools: validate addresses, list carriers and services, quote shipments, create labels, track packages, cancel shipments, schedule pickups, retrieve shipment history, classify HS/NCM codes, and generate customs invoices.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Envia Shipping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Envia Shipping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.envia.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Envia Shipping MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envia Shipping lists 72 MCP tools, including envia_add_ticket_comment, envia_ai_address_requirements, envia_ai_parse_address, envia_cancel_pickup, envia_cancel_shipment, envia_check_balance, envia_classify_hscode, envia_create_address, envia_create_client, envia_create_international_shipment, envia_create_package, and envia_create_shipment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Envia Shipping?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Envia Shipping in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Envia Shipping MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envia Shipping requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Envia Shipping is developed by Envia.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
